name: Conversational Forms for Elementor Forms
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
Conversational Forms for Elementor Forms transforms your standard Elementor Forms into an interactive, chat-like experience — similar to Typeform or Google Form conversational mode.

Instead of showing all fields at once, each question appears one by one with smooth scrolling and beautiful transitions, making your forms more engaging and user-friendly.

DEMO: https://demo.add-ons.org/conversational-forms-demo/
Document: https://add-ons.org/document-image-choices-image-picker-for-elementor-form/
Download Pro Version: https://add-ons.org/plugin/conversational-forms-for-elementor-forms-pro/

Features

  • One-question-at-a-time conversational interface
  • Smooth auto-scroll with keyboard navigation (Enter / Tab / Shift + Enter)
  • Progress bar and step counter in footer
  • Support for all Elementor Form field types
  • Automatic scroll to invalid or required fields
  • Mobile-friendly and lightweight (no external libraries)
  • Developer-friendly — easily extendable with hooks & filters

Bring a conversational experience to your Elementor Forms — no extra setup, just activate and start creating!

Perfect for

  • Lead generation forms
  • Surveys and quizzes
  • Registration and feedback forms
  • Multi-step contact or booking forms
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/conversational-forms-for-elementor-forms directory, or install directly through Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open any Elementor Form widget.
  4. Enable the Conversational Form option in “Actions After Submit”.
  5. Save and preview your form — it will now appear as an interactive chat-like flow.
sections.faq:
Is it compatible with reCAPTCHA or third-party add-ons?

Yes. Google reCAPTCHA (non-invisible) is supported, and most Elementor form add-ons are compatible.

Will it affect my existing form submissions?

No. The plugin only changes the front-end layout; your submissions, integrations, and email actions remain unchanged.

Does it work with custom styling or themes?

Yes, you can fully customize CSS for colors, fonts, and spacing.
